summary: Iteration 12 — GRC Portfolio Overview redesign. Backend pytest 14/14 passing against real preview backend (super_admin token). Verified: (a) response shape includes all new portfolio keys (past_due, due_30d, due_31_90d, critical_high_open, unassigned, clients_requiring_attention, total_clients, generated_at) + legacy keys + attention_queue + team_workload; (b) non-overlap — one overdue + one due-in-15-days yields past_due=1, due_30d=1 (not 2 in past_due); (c) de-duplication — a critical finding + a critical task with finding_id linking to it yields past_due=1 AND critical_high_open=1 (not 2); (d) unassigned counts all four types (review + task-no-finding + finding + risk) = 4; (e) risk without next_review is NOT in past_due/due_30d/due_31_90d, risk with next_review<now IS in past_due; (f) archived client excluded by default, included with include_archived=true; (g) program_status rule engine: critical-overdue → action_required, onboarding preserved, clean → healthy; (h) attention_queue is <=15 items and globally sorted non-decreasing by priority bucket; (i) team_workload only contains super_admin/platform_admin users; (j) RBAC 403 for acme-contributor@example.test; (k) weekly digest regression POST /api/reminders/send-weekly-now returns ok=true. Frontend Playwright (super_admin) on /clients confirmed: header 'GRC Portfolio Overview'; all 6 portfolio cards (card-past-due, card-due-30d, card-due-31-90, card-critical-high, card-unassigned, card-attention-clients) render with correct counts (13/17/13/9/29/1-of-1); attention-queue, client-portfolio-table, team-workload, client-lead-filter all render; all 8 filter tabs (client-filter-{all,assigned_to_me,action_required,needs_attention,past_due,critical_high,onboarding,archived}) present and clickable; drill dialog opens for past_due (11 rows, all 'overdue'), critical_high (6 rows, sev in critical/high only), unassigned (12 rows); portfolio table cells client-past-due-0/client-due-30-0/client-critical-0/client-unassigned-0 all render; workload-row-0/1 present; regression /dashboard /policies /vendors /action-items all load 200.

minor.issue: platform-admin@example.test has role=client_contributor in seeded preview DB (not platform_admin as declared in /app/memory/test_credentials.md). GET /api/clients/directory correctly returns 403 for this account. Either the seeder needs to update this user's role to platform_admin on startup, or the test-credentials doc is stale. Backend tests fell back to admin@example.test (super_admin) to exercise the endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testids workload-critical-<i> and workload-open-<i> are only rendered when the metric value is > 0 (MetricCell renders a plain <span> without data-testid when value=0). Spec requires these testids to always render. Portfolio-table metric cells have the same behavior (client-past-due-<i>, client-due-30-<i>, client-critical-<i>, client-unassigned-<i> only render when value>0). Automated tests looking for these selectors when a client has 0 in a bucket will fail.

action_items: Seed fix: ensure the startup seeder promotes platform-admin@example.test to role=platform_admin (currently role=client_contributor in preview DB — endpoint returns 403 as if it were a contributor). Verify against /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

Frontend MetricCell: always render the data-testid on the cell (both the clickable button when value>0 and the span when value=0) so workload-critical-<i>, workload-open-<i>, client-past-due-<i>, client-due-30-<i>, client-critical-<i>, client-unassigned-<i> testids exist on every row regardless of value.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 3586 lines — still >5x the 700-line guideline. The redesigned /clients/directory alone is ~425 lines with rich helpers (_due_bucket, _priority_rank, _bump_workload, _push); good candidate to extract into backend/routes/clients_portfolio.py.
ClientDirectory.jsx is 711 lines — sits right at the file-size guideline. AttentionCard, MetricCell, DrillDialog, AddClientDialog, ClientRowMenu could each move to /components for readability.
The directory route reads audit_logs with .to_list(50000) — on a large tenant this will scan a lot of history. Add a projection+time-window ($gt: 90d) to reduce the working set.
attention_queue trims to top 15 after global sort; consider surfacing per-client counts of 'items suppressed below cutoff' so UIs can hint at hidden work. Not blocking.

Team workload only counts explicit owner_id/assignee_id; the doc-string says so but a dashed 'unassigned' contribution is not attributed anywhere in team_workload — matches spec, but consider a synthetic 'Unassigned' row so leadership can see gap-of-ownership.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all required testids and flows render for rows with non-zero values; missing testids on zero-value MetricCells is the sole gap

test_credentials: admin@example.test / TEST_ONLY_ADMIN_PASSWORD (super_admin — used for backend + UI tests because platform-admin@example.test is currently role=client_contributor in the seeded preview DB). acme-contributor@example.test / TEST_ONLY_PASSWORD (verified 403 on /clients/directory).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create then archive several TEST_iter12_* clients (Portfolio, ArchivedTenant, dedup, unassigned, risks, status_ar, status_onb, status_clean, attn) plus their child reviews/findings/risks/tasks. No delete endpoint for clients exists, so each is archived at teardown (renamed on the primary test client for uniqueness). If run repeatedly, archived TEST_iter12_* clients will accumulate — safe because include_archived defaults to false so they don't skew portfolio counts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /api/clients/directory endpoint is stable and well-tested. When testing UI /clients page, log in as admin@example.test (super_admin) — platform-admin@example.test currently maps to a client_contributor role in the seeded DB and hits the endpoint's 403. If seeder is fixed to promote it, either credential works. When asserting portfolio-table or team-workload metric testids, note that MetricCell only emits the data-testid when value>0 — assertions must tolerate absent testids for zero-value cells until the frontend fix ships. Backend tests file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12.py runs in ~6s and cleans up by archiving.
rca of the issue: platform-admin@example.test has the wrong role in the seeded DB (client_contributor vs platform_admin). RCA: the seed function likely creates the user with a default role and does not enforce/refresh the role on subsequent boots. Mitigation: in seed_admin (or the equivalent seed_users) function, upsert with $set: {role: 'platform_admin'} for platform-admin@example.test so the role is corrected on every startup. Verify with: curl -s -X POST $BASE/api/auth/login -d '{"email":"platform-admin@example.test","password":"TEST_ONLY_PASSWORD"}' | jq '.user.role' → should print 'platform_admin'.
